items.ruling: Before/after reads left to right, not top to bottom. BeforeAfterWindow lays each Before/After pair SIDE BY SIDE - Before left, After right. A window opens at the size of what is IN it: its width and height follow the elements it holds, and the elements must never occupy less than 50% of the window. A user resize grows the window AND the elements in it. THE SPACE & LEGIBILITY LAW: nothing the user must read is cut off, and nothing starves while its window holds empty space.
